forensicsFindings: Existing MissionWorkManager already provides dependency-aware durable MissionTask state, leases, retries, review and reclamation.
Existing AgentWorkforceStore already provides workspace-scoped agent identity, ACTIVE/PAUSED/ARCHIVED lifecycle, and capability references.
Existing AgentIntercomStore provides mission-scoped communication and governed delegation; Wave 5 composes it rather than replacing it.
Existing DurableEventBus provides the event substrate; Wave 5 adds a durable workspace-scoped Fleet Activity projection.
No existing automation recipe abstraction or reusable mission launch composition was found, so Wave 5 introduces that layer.
changes: Added versioned Mission Automation Recipe contracts and persistence.

Added launch idempotency and durable launch records.

Added durable Fleet Activity projection from DurableEventBus.
Added mission/agent/topic activity filters with cursor pagination.
Added authenticated recipe and activity APIs.
Added Overseer Dashboard Fleet Orchestration UI.
